name: A Greater Imp below level 28 keeps Imp Rush and its autocast choice across a mount (#11553)
contract: #11553 reports a level 12 Fleshwarden gets "my Greater Imp has learned Imp Rush and the ability has been turned
off" on every dismount. Mounting temporarily unsummons the pet and dismounting reloads it. Imp Rush (630931) is
taught by the Xoroth refresh, so a reload that unlearns it below its level 28 makes the refresh teach it again,
which sends the client a pet-learned-spell packet (SMSG_PET_LEARNED_SPELL, 0x499) and resets the autocast choice.
Expected: a level 13 Fleshwarden whose imp has Imp Rush with autocast turned off gets no further pet-learned-spell
packet over a mount and dismount, the imp still knows Imp Rush, and its autocast is still off.
